quotes.text: - Dedicado a las labores del hogar
- Responsabilidades de cuidado de hijos u otros familiares
- Quiere cuidar personalmente de hijos u otros familiares

assessments.reasoning:
Regarding 'responsibility', the instrument contains no questions asking who is in charge, plans, organizes, or is responsible for domestic or care work.

Regarding 'performance', the instrument features options such as '- Dedicado a las labores del hogar' in Section H (SIDIV1) and care responsibilities as reasons for part-time work or inactivity (e.g., '- Responsabilidades de cuidado de hijos u otros familiares' in PARCO2 and '- Quiere cuidar personally de hijos u otros familiares' in PCONC1). However, per the indicator definition, activity status categories and reasons for working part-time or not seeking work do not count as questions asking whether a person carries out domestic or care tasks.

Regarding 'magnitude', the instrument records time spent only for paid employment and work-related absences, and contains no questions measuring hours or frequency of unpaid domestic or care work.
